widgets.title: Where should your business start?
widgets.use: General entry point. Good on the homepage, the Resources menu and the first slide of any proposal.

widgets.title: How many hours does hand work cost your team?
widgets.use: Sales calls and RevOps proposals. The one number makes the case for automation.

widgets.title: Is your Google Ads account ready to spend?
widgets.use: Paid media proposals and PPC landing pages. Surfaces setup gaps before a client pays for management.

widgets.title: Can you see what your marketing does?
widgets.use: Any proposal kickoff slide, or the onboarding email. Most clients score lower than they expect.

widgets.title: Can Google and AI search find your site?
widgets.use: SEO and AI SEO proposals, blog sidebars, and the AI SEO service page.

widgets.title: Could you say yes to a journalist this week?
widgets.use: Digital PR proposals and thought-leadership pages. Shows what a client must have ready before pitching starts.

widgets.title: Will your emails reach the inbox?
widgets.use: Email marketing proposals, ecommerce pages and onboarding. Since Google and Yahoo tightened bulk-sender rules, most lists have a gap here.
